BiblicalUsage: Siddim is the vale where the kings fought, the valley of the salt sea where the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah joined battle with the kings of the east, and where the slimepits swallowed the fleeing kings. Abram heard of it and armed his trained servants to rescue Lot.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the vale of Siddim is where Abram proved his faith. Four kings against five, and Abram went after them, and I hold that the man of faith does not leave his brother in the pits.
